crew.overview: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.
crew.title: Up

crew.overview: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.
crew.title: The Hunger Games

details.biography: Cassandra served as the Vice President of Legal Affairs Administration for Sony Pictures Studios (and its predecessors, TriStar Pictures and TriStar Television) for 14 years. Cassandra was a founding member of Clear, Inc., the entertainment industry’s foremost content acquisition organization, where she served as Co-Executive Director, and a member of the Board of Directors for Screenlife, LLC, creators of "Scene It?".
details.name: Cassandra Barbour
